title: Deepfake Porn Sites Use [person]'s Image Without Consent

behaviors.text: Porn sites are alleged to have used AI-generated images of [person] without her consent, leading to severe emotional distress.
Liu discovered a video of herself on Pornhub, which was then deepfaked and spread across over 800 links.
Despite efforts to remove the content, many sites refused to comply, perpetuating the violation and exploitation of her image.
